Third-party files, kept locally so the app works offline.

- `ogg-opus-decoder.min.js` — ogg-opus-decoder 1.7.5 (MIT, Ethan Halsall, https://github.com/eshaz/wasm-audio-decoders), `dist/ogg-opus-decoder.min.js` from npm with the source-map comment removed. Used only when the browser cannot decode Ogg Opus itself (Safari).
- `fonts/barlow-800-latin.woff2`, `fonts/barlowcond-{600,700,800}-latin.woff2` — Barlow ExtraBold and Barlow Condensed, latin subset, from Google Fonts. SIL Open Font License 1.1, see `fonts/OFL-Barlow.txt`.
